title: Return to Marius without the leg

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: I was hoping you'd have a little more leg with you than that. Did you speak to Aengus?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was hoping you'd have a little more leg with you than that. Did you speak to Aengus?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: What?! But I...I thought I double checked... I must have... Mustn't I?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?! But I...I thought I double checked... I must have... Mustn't I?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Just rub it in why don't you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just rub it in why don't you?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: You think? That's very kind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think? That's very kind.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: After that, I'm going to work out how to work my way up that leader board!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: After that, I'm going to work out how to work my way up that leader board!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I spoke to Aengus. He said he used your genome to practice his maths skills.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I spoke to Aengus. He said he used your genome to practice his maths skills.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I spoke to Aengus. He said he used your genome to practice his maths skills.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I spoke to Aengus. He said he used your genome to practice his maths skills.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Yes, I know. That bit was obvious. I want to know why he hasn't returned it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, I know. That bit was obvious. I want to know why he hasn't returned it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: According to him, that was never part of the deal. He always discards the remains.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: According to him, that was never part of the deal. He always discards the remains.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: According to him, that was never part of the deal. He always discards the remains.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: According to him, that was never part of the deal. He always discards the remains.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's an easy mistake to make.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's an easy mistake to make.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's an easy mistake to make.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's an easy mistake to make.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure how you could possibly not double check that!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure how you could possibly not double check that!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure how you could possibly not double check that!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure how you could possibly not double check that!

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: I was under a lot of pressure. Starting a business, looking up to someone like Aengus, I really just wanted him to take me under his wing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was under a lot of pressure. Starting a business, looking up to someone like Aengus, I really just wanted him to take me under his wing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you tried to buy his mentorship with your own body?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you tried to buy his mentorship with your own body?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you tried to buy his mentorship with your own body?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you tried to buy his mentorship with your own body?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Well I was technically just renting because I thought I'd get it back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I was technically just renting because I thought I'd get it back.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How is any of this obvious? It's all insane!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How is any of this obvious? It's all insane!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How is any of this obvious? It's all insane!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How is any of this obvious? It's all insane!

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Read any chef's biography. All the greats gave part of themselves to this job.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Read any chef's biography. All the greats gave part of themselves to this job.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes, but not literally!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, but not literally!

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: I thought I'd have it back by now!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I thought I'd have it back by now!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The new leg does suit you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The new leg does suit you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The new leg does suit you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The new leg does suit you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This is kind of completely your fault.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is kind of completely your fault.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This is kind of completely your fault.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This is kind of completely your fault.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What now?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Well firstly, I'm going to pay you for your time. I know it wasn't the result I wanted but you did what I asked.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well firstly, I'm going to pay you for your time. I know it wasn't the result I wanted but you did what I asked.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think I know what Aengus would tell you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think I know what Aengus would tell you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think I know what Aengus would tell you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think I know what Aengus would tell you.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: What's that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's all just a numbers game.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's all just a numbers game.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's all just a numbers game.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's all just a numbers game.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And then?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I appreciate that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I appreciate that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Expect me to be there!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Expect me to be there!

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Won't cost me a leg, I hope!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Won't cost me a leg, I hope!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's the only one you still got.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's the only one you still got.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's the only one you still got.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's the only one you still got.
